description: Fork of exp635 (FFN + v_lut = 1.4301 @ 317M). Single additional change: replace the attention output projection (self.proj, Linear n_embd -> n_embd) with a TinyMultiHeadLut (NAP=6, tph=1024, hybrid_smooth) matching the FFN/v_lut shape. Now three LUTs per block: v_lut, out_lut, FFN lut. Only qk_proj remains Linear in attention. The zero-init residual identity is replaced by relying on mhlut_init_std=0.001 (the same approach FFN already uses). Reference: exp328 vanilla = 1.3882, exp633 = 1.4584, exp634 = 1.4372, exp635 = 1.4301.
